name: an outgoing queue fills, is paced, and ends the connection when nothing drains it
description: The outgoing half of the one backpressure rule, which no scenario could hold while an emit waited for its frame to drain: an emit resolves when the frame was accepted for sending, so a sender reaches the frame that meets a full queue and is paced. Held over an in-process pair nothing reads, the one transport a scenario can fill, and mirrored so that each language is held over its own. How a peer ends a connection whose consumer never drained is its transport's — a close of its own or an abort — and what is held is that it ended.

steps.note: an in-process pair nothing reads unasked: a socket's own buffers take far more than a scenario can send

emits until one meets the queue full: what the transport holds, what the writer has in hand and what the queue holds all take one first, and the one after that is paced for a write deadline — which an emit that waited on the drain could never reach, the second never returning
paced, and the peer is still whole: a full queue is a burst until its deadline passes
and nothing drained it within the deadline, so the peer that could not write is disconnected rather than left holding the connection up
